noise-pollution-decibels.alt: Horizontal bar chart of sound levels from the CDC: whisper 30 dB, refrigerator 40, normal conversation 65 to 80, lawn mower 80 to 100, sports event 94 to 110, siren 110 to 129, fireworks 140 to 160. A dashed line at 85 dB marks where hearing damage can begin over time.
